description.en: A small abraded fungal fragment preserves a layer of round-to-elliptical pores.
description.zh: 小型磨蚀真菌残片保存圆至椭圆孔层。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Quatsinoporites cranhamii, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Quatsinoporites cranhamii 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: A poroid tissue block differs structurally from the gilled mushroom; a complete shelf outline is not known.
distinctness.zh: 孔状组织块在结构上区别于具褶蘑菇，完整层架外形未知。

modeling_brief.en: Model one irregular specimen block with an exposed pore layer; keep broken boundaries rather than inventing a bracket cap.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作单件不规则标本块及露出孔层，保留断边，不臆造层孔菌盖。

uncertainty: Only a pore-layer fragment is known; full fruiting body and exact family placement are uncertain.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Cretaceous and Eocene poroid hymenophores from Vancouver Island
